title.zh: India moves to block 15 crypto apps, leaving users facing sudden account lockout
title.en: India moves to block 15 crypto apps, leaving users facing sudden account lockout

current_state.zh: India's Financial Intelligence Unit issued non-compliance notices to 15 crypto providers under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act and sought takedowns of their apps and URLs, putting Indian users at risk of sudden loss of access to these services.
current_state.en: India's Financial Intelligence Unit issued non-compliance notices to 15 crypto providers under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act and sought takedowns of their apps and URLs, putting Indian users at risk of sudden loss of access to these services.
